facts.value: The Aeronautical Engineering course at UL is your gateway into the hugely exciting aerospace industry.
This elite course is one of the most respected in Europe.
Supported by outstanding facilities, including wind tunnels and composites manufacturing equipment.
Job prospects have never been brighter for Aerospace Engineers, with a major shortage in Europe.
More than 70% of our graduates work in the Aerospace industry and 63% live in the Republic of Ireland.
In 3rd year, top performing students can spend a semester at Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University in Florida, USA, or at Georgia Institute of Technology in Atlanta, USA.
Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University, Georgia Institute of Technology.
This course is accredited by Engineers Ireland.
